title: blob.rs: use Self:: instead of full path for check_auth_status
description: In blob.rs, inside an impl JmapClient block, check_auth_status is called as crate::client::JmapClient::check_auth_status(status) rather than Self::check_auth_status(status). Inside an impl block, Self:: is the idiomatic way to call methods on the same type. This also reduces churn if the type is ever renamed. Suggested rewrite: replace crate::client::JmapClient::check_auth_status(status) with Self::check_auth_status(status) in both upload_blob and download_blob.
